flags: MENU: 7 sections, 44 items, from their DoorDash Commerce Platform storefront (order.online/store/my-o-my-24879974, 'My-O-My (Euclid Ave)'), in their section order and names. Their Instagram links nothing and has no Order button, so the storefront is NOT linked from anything of theirs; it is in their name at their address and is their own commission-free ordering page rather than the DoorDash marketplace (the Patty's Diner / Fresh Fuel Juicery precedent). DoorDash, Uber Eats, Postmates and Grubhub marketplace listings were not used.

PRICES are the base (small) size as the storefront shows them, e.g. Chicken on the Rocks small $12.00, regular +$2.40, large +$6.00; wraps regular, large +$3.60; poutines small, regular, large; toppings +$0.60, extra sauces +$1.20. Said once in siteNote. The prices end in odd cents ($12.00, $13.20, $14.40, $25.20), about 20% above the Telegraph shop's ($11.99, $12.99 ...); that is their storefront's own pricing and is used as published.

LEFT OUT: the 'Most Ordered' section (repeats); 'Fries Wrap Combo' ($7.20) and 'Salad Wrap Combo' ($6.00), which are add-ons to a wrap rather than dishes. No alcohol, gift cards or merchandise on the menu. Drinks (water, juice, soda) kept.

DESCRIPTIONS shortened from theirs; '670 cal.' dropped from the platters. Two descriptions are marked on the storefront 'Description generated by DoorDash using AI' (Fries, Beef Poutine) and were rewritten from those items' own options (sizes; cheese curds or mozzarella, beef or vegetarian gravy). Not every item's modal was opened, so other AI-marked descriptions are possible; the ones used are plain ingredient lists. Items with no description on the storefront have "". Typos fixed: 'Tumeric Rice' Turmeric Rice, 'like the do back home' (rewritten), 'Beef On The Rocks' cased like its neighbours. 'Fatoush' kept as they spell it. 'Chicken' and 'Beef' in Apps & Sides are the meat alone (small, regular +$6, large +$12 for chicken), distinct from 'Side of Chicken'/'Side of Beef'.

HOURS: only one source gives them, the storefront's 'store's actual hours of operation' (Mon-Fri 11am-11:30pm, Sat-Sun 12pm-11:30pm); online ordering stops at 11:10pm. Their Instagram gives none, so nothing disagrees. An old East Bay Magazine listing (not used) had different hours. Coordinator may drop `hours` if one ordering-page source is not enough.

PHONE (510) 356-4460 is the storefront's store phone (storePhoneNumber in its page data); not shown on their Instagram. The Telegraph shop's (510) 529-4063 is a different shop's number and is not used. No email published.

If the coordinator rejects an unlinked storefront, fall back to items: [], a contactOnly sentence, site = their Instagram with siteCta 'See their Instagram'.

TWO MY-O-MYS IN BERKELEY, NOT A CHAIN ACROSS CITIES. (1) This one, 'My O My Berkeley', 1866 Euclid Ave (Northside), @myomyeuclidberkeley, green roundel logo, 'Shawarma Done Right'. (2) 'My-O-My', 2431 Telegraph Ave (Southside), @my.o.my.shawarma, red MY-O-MY logo, 'Canadian inspired Mediterranean food', its own site myomyrestaurant.com. Press (What Now SF, Feb 2023 and Sep 2025; not used for facts) says My-O-My took over D'Yar at 1866 Euclid in 2023 (owner Javed Ahmadi, also of Chopan Kabob in Concord, Sacramento and San Ramon) and in Sep 2025 was 'preparing to open' at 2431 Telegraph (co-owner Abdul Ahmadi). The Euclid shop is still open with its own new Instagram and its own storefront named 'My-O-My (Euclid Ave)'; the menus are the same concept (half-half bowls, donair, poutine, spice levels), so it is likely the same family, but their exact relationship is not stated anywhere first-party. The Telegraph site tells a two-brothers story (one runs restaurants around Toronto, names not given) and lists only Telegraph. No 'My O My' found in any other city; Chopan Kabob is a different name. Seat only this Euclid shop. NOTE categorySeats' family(): 'My O My Berkeley' and a future 'My-O-My' would be different family keys ('my-o-my-berkeley' vs 'my-o-my'), so if the Telegraph shop is ever added the coordinator should decide whether they count as one family.
